task_message:
Case M39: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 420x420x252 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M39 is finished. 

**Summary:**
- **Finding:** A large, lobulated, markedly T2-hyperintense pelvic mass (≈61 × 95 × 77 mm, ~245 mL) centered above the pubic symphysis, slightly right of midline — the only lesion in the volume across all three planes.
- **Segmentation:** Started with a point prompt at the mass center (v1, 225.9 mL), refined the boundary with the model (v2), then added a 1 mm dilation (v3) to include the thin fibrous capsule/rim.
- **Verification:** Checked the mask at upper/lower poles and lateral ends in axial, coronal and sagittal planes; the final review showed the outline following the lesion boundary with no contiguous tissue beyond the mask ends. Intensity-based candidates (pubic symphysis rim, prostate/seminal-vesicle region, peripelvic vessels) were judged normal anatomy and rejected.
- **Confidence:** medium — boundary is clean in all three planes, but the lesion's fluid-like signal left slight uncertainty about exact tissue identity (myxoid tumor vs. fluid-filled structure).
